design.decision: Your team bids knowing both partners are void in [♣] and long in [♦], so it plans to trump [♣] leads and run [♦] late, and it bids higher.
design.opponent: Shown the first time your team ruffs or discards on a [♣] lead; opponents learn to stop leading [♣] and to shorten their own [♦]s to overruff.
design.rationale: This is the rare whole-suit version of the measured source-filtered hand changes: one void plus one very long suit, which is a real Spades edge before any payoff is owned. It differs from uc-clubs-to-spades in count and destination and is the [♦]-first Suits enabler the pool lacks.

critic.concerns: Exactly the effect of cut common ca-diamond-become-from-clubs, which measured lift -14.5 [-15.6, -13.3]; price alone is unlikely to fix that, so confirm whether AI bidding misjudged it, and it is near-redundant with ra-all-diamonds.
